items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: I loved him. I used to hug him every time I saw him, you know, because --

ctx.x: Yeah. He was so little, you know. I think Ben nicknamed him, you know. Well, what are you going to do? I loved him. I used to hug him every time I saw him, you know, because --
And this great album that Duke wrote called "And His Mother Named Him Bill."
